Future<void> mapped(groups, read) async {
  while (true) {
    for (final batch in groups) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await Future.wait(
        batch.map((item) async {
          await read(item);
        }),
      );
    }
  }
}

Future<void> built(groups, checks, read) async {
  while (true) {
    for (final batch in groups) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await Future.wait([
        for (final item in batch)
          () async {
            await read(item);
            for (final check in checks) {
              // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
              await check(item);
            }
          }(),
      ]);
    }
  }
}
